sources.title: CogBench: Cognitive Evaluation Benchmarks
sources.snippet: CogBench refers to a set of benchmark frameworks and datasets optimized for rigorous, cognitively-grounded evaluation of artificial agents—especially LLMs—in ways that probe human-like reasoning, dynamic adaptation, and neural processing. Several distinct resources carry the CogBench name or scope, including MulCogBench for model–brain alignment, longitudinal cognitive dynamics ...
